title: Key Project Management Terms
terms: [{"icon":"📋","label":"Scope","definition":"The defined boundaries of a project — what work will and will not be included. A clear scope statement prevents scope creep and gives the team a shared understanding of deliverables, constraints, and exclusions."},{"icon":"⏱","label":"Schedule","definition":"A time-ordered plan that sequences tasks, assigns durations, and identifies dependencies. The schedule is the primary tool for tracking progress and communicating timeline commitments to stakeholders."},{"icon":"💰","label":"Budget","definition":"The approved financial baseline for the project, covering labour, materials, and overheads. Effective budget management requires tracking actuals against the baseline and forecasting spend to completion."},{"icon":"⚠️","label":"Risk","definition":"An uncertain event or condition that, if it occurs, has a positive or negative effect on project objectives. Risk management involves identification, assessment, response planning, and ongoing monitoring throughout the project lifecycle."}]
